text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Suri Rumah (Perbekalan bagi Tahun 2022) 2023.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2022

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi satu juta tujuh ribu ringgit

(RM1,007,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial Suri Rumah bagi

perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan Sosial Suri Rumah bagi tahun 2022

adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 143,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 81,000

Perbelanjaan lain 50,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 733,000

JUMLAH 1,007,000

Dibuat 17 Ogos 2023

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/1/31/7(4); PN/(PU2)747/III]

SIVAKUMAR A/L VARATHARAJU NAIDU

Menteri Sumber Manusia

HOUSEWIVES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2022

HOUSEWIVES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY FOR THE YEAR 2022)

REGULATIONS 2023

IN excercise of the powers conferred by subsection 54(1)

of the Housewives' Social Security Act 2022 [Act 838], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Housewives' Social Security (Supply for

the Year 2022) Regulations 2023.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2022

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding one million seven thousand ringgit

(RM1,007,000) from the Housewives' Social Security Fund for the expenditure on

administration of the Housewives' Social Security Scheme for the year 2022 is hereby

authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 143,000

Supplies and services 81,000

Other expenditures 50,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 733,000

TOTAL 1,007,000

Made 17 August 2023

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/1/31/7(4); PN/(PU2)747/III]

 SIVAKUMAR A/L VARATHARAJU NAIDU

 Minister of Human Resources
